name: Launchpad routines
about: The five routine offers. Times are defaults the person can change. Each scheduled prompt and trigger is set up with Cowork's own tools and approved on Cowork's own card. Results are drafts; nothing is sent.

routines.label: Monday priorities
routines.description: 08:00 each Monday: what matters this week
routines.name: Monday priorities
routines.what: Up to five priorities for the week, the meetings that need preparation and what is waiting on you
routines.reads: Your calendar for the week, mail subjects from last week, and your Launchpad profile if you saved one
routines.produces: A one-page view of the week, in the conversation
routines.prompt: Look at my calendar for this week, the subjects of mail I sent or flagged last week, and my Launchpad profile in my Cowork folder if I saved one. Draft a one-page view of what matters this week: up to five priorities, the meetings that need preparation, and anything waiting on me. Leave out anything private, confidential, personal, HR or medical. Draft only; do not send, post or share anything.
routines.starter: Every Monday at 08:00, draft my priorities for the week from my calendar and mail subjects. Draft only, send nothing.

routines.label: Morning brief
routines.description: 07:30 on working days: your day at a glance
routines.name: Morning brief
routines.what: Your meetings and what each needs from you, what is due today, and mail that needs a reply
routines.produces: A short brief for the day, in the conversation
routines.prompt: Brief me on today: my meetings and what each needs from me, anything due today, and mail from the last day that needs a reply from me. Leave out anything private, confidential, personal, HR or medical. Keep it to one screen. Draft only; do not send, post or share anything.
routines.starter: Every working day at 07:30, brief me on my day: meetings and what each needs from me, what is due, and mail that needs a reply. Draft only, send nothing.

routines.label: Meeting preparation
routines.description: The evening before meetings that need a pack
routines.name: Meeting preparation
routines.what: A one-page brief for each meeting that needs a pack: purpose, what changed, open actions and questions
routines.reads: Your meetings on the next working day, and the files and mail about them that you can see
routines.produces: One page per meeting that needs a pack, in the conversation
routines.prompt: Look at my meetings on the next working day. For each one that needs a pack (a review, committee, board or business review, or six or more people), prepare a one-page brief: its purpose, what changed since last time, open actions and the questions to ask. Use only what I can already see, and say not stated where something is missing. Leave out anything private, confidential, personal, HR or medical. Draft only; do not send, post or share anything.
routines.starter: Every working day at 17:00, prepare me for tomorrow's meetings that need a pack. Draft only, send nothing.

routines.label: Schedule a kept skill
routines.description: Run one of your skills at a time you choose
routines.name: A kept skill on a schedule
routines.what: Runs a skill you kept, for example on the 5th of each month
routines.reads: What the skill reads, for the period it runs
routines.produces: The skill's draft, in the conversation
routines.prompt_template: Run my {skill} skill for the latest period. Draft only; do not send, post or share anything.
routines.starter: Run my {skill} skill on the 5th of each month at 08:00. Draft only, send nothing.

routines.label: Start a skill from email
routines.description: Run a skill when a matching email arrives
routines.name: A kept skill when an email arrives
routines.what: Runs a skill you kept, for example when the ledger-locked email arrives

needs: the sender, resolved to an email address

routines.reads: The email that arrives, and what the skill reads
routines.produces: The skill's draft, for your review
routines.prompt_template: Run my {skill} skill for the period named in this email and leave the draft for my review. Do not send, post or share anything.
routines.starter: When the {subject} email arrives, run my {skill} skill and leave the draft for my review.
